high_level_description: A solemn vertical fantasy pilgrimage poster for the Temple of Solunus. A single colossal cult statue of the dual sun-and-moon deity stands in a shallow shrine alcove pressed directly against a golden shrine wall, which fills the ENTIRE background of the illustration like a flat backdrop. The camera is close and low, at a kneeling worshipper's eye level, so the statue nearly fills the frame. This is a TIGHT CLOSE VIEW of the shrine only: no deep hall, no side aisles, no arcade, no far wall, no distant floor, no niches, no colonnade. The statue's body is split down the exact vertical center line into two materials: polished black obsidian on the left, radiant gold on the right. There is exactly ONE figure in the entire image — no lesser gods, no side idols, no statues in niches, no busts, no people. Painted fantasy key art with visible brushstrokes and aged printed-poster paper grain, warm gold and black palette, framed by a heavy carved wood and riveted iron border with gilded crescent corner ornaments and medieval serif typography in the top and bottom panels.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A single flat wall of gold-leaf cladding filling the whole background edge to edge, embossed with large abstract sun-disc and crescent reliefs and engraved geometric borders. The wall is close behind the statue — no depth, no room beyond it, no doorways, no windows, no niches, no arches, no other walls visible. Only a narrow strip of polished marble floor at the very bottom. One diagonal shaft of pale daylight enters from off-frame at the upper right through faint incense haze.

elements.desc: A prominent header carved into the dark top panel of the frame, in elegant clean medieval serif capitals with gilded edges.

The framed illustration: a tight, close, low-angle view of one shrine alcove. The golden shrine wall is the only background. NO hall interior, NO side walls, NO niches, NO arcade, NO windows, NO distant architecture.

The ONLY figure in the image: a colossal cult statue of the deity Solunus, standing frontally, back almost touching the golden wall, filling most of the frame height. Long heavy draped robes with engraved hems, bare feet, calm serene androgynous elven face looking straight at the viewer.

MATERIAL SPLIT: a razor-sharp vertical seam down the exact center of the statue, from the top of the head through the middle of the face, sternum and robes to the feet. Everything LEFT of the seam is polished BLACK OBSIDIAN — deep glassy black stone, wet glossy sheen, tiny white star flecks embedded in it. Everything RIGHT of the seam is polished RADIANT GOLD — warm burnished gilded metal with engraved ornament. One clean hard edge, no blending, no gradient.

The head and its crown: NO spiked gothic crown, NO jagged tiara. Instead a plain low smooth band diadem sits on the brow, and behind the head rises a flat radiant HALO of long slender pointed golden rays fanning outward like a sunburst, plus a large thin SILVER CRESCENT MOON with sharp horns and a few small silver stars arcing behind the halo.

ARM COUNT: the statue has EXACTLY SIX arms and no more — precisely THREE arms on the left obsidian side and THREE arms on the right golden side, evenly spaced down the torso. Do not add a fourth arm on either side. Do not add extra hands or floating hands. Six arms total, six hands total.

LEFT ARM 1 (upper, obsidian): raised high, holding aloft a BLACK SUN DISC — a round plate of rough matte-black stone densely sprinkled with tiny white star specks, rimmed with a thin gold edge and backed by a fan of pointed golden sun rays.
LEFT ARM 2 (middle, obsidian): extended sideways, glossy black hand open with palm turned toward the viewer in a gesture of blessing, bright specular highlights along the polished knuckles.
LEFT ARM 3 (lower, obsidian): hanging relaxed along the robe, fingers loosely curled, holding nothing.
RIGHT ARM 1 (upper, gold): raised, holding a GOLDEN SUN DISC — a convex polished gold plate with a swirling molten cloud texture, encircled by a dense ring of short triangular golden spikes.
RIGHT ARM 2 (middle, gold): bent inward, gilded fingers cradling a small ornate silver reliquary orb.
RIGHT ARM 3 (lower, gold): hanging relaxed along the robe, palm open and turned outward, holding nothing.

A wide low TIERED PEDESTAL directly beneath the statue: veined white marble capped by a broad polished gold band, on a stepped gold-clad plinth of three receding ledges. A round golden sun medallion with short pointed rays is mounted at the center of the marble front face. Nothing else stands on or beside it.

elements.text: One god, two faces — life and death. Healing is given at his door; no illness is turned away. Pilgrims of every race are welcome.
elements.desc: A call-to-action text block on the bottom panel of the frame, in a clean legible medieval serif font.
